title: Aviva Will appears on The Hub and Spoke podcast
summary: On The Hub and Spoke podcast, Vice Chair Aviva Will discusses what it takes to build a successful affirmative litigation program. The conversation covers four foundational pillars, alongside changes in the legal finance market and how companies are rethinking the role of litigation. Learn more.
body_markdown:
On *The Hub and Spoke* podcast, Vice Chair[Aviva Will](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/aviva-will/) discusses what it takes to build a successful affirmative litigation program. The conversation covers four foundational pillars, alongside changes in the legal finance market and how companies are rethinking the role of litigation.


Listen[here](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/how-to-use-litigation-finance-to-turn-your-corporate/id1777862450?i=1000758235205) or below.
